findings.label: HUB_SECTIONS static .light palette read
findings.detail: HUB_SECTIONS[].color reads HUB_SECTION_COLOR.light.*. That is a module-scope colour in a non-allowed palette read form, and it contradicts the w2-plan's 'don't keep a module-scope colour'. The data is dead (nothing renders HubSection.color), and the unowned tripStructureRegression snapshot pins the light hexes.
findings.action: Integrator: either drop or replace HubSection.color and re-record the tripStructureRegression snapshot, or explicitly accept it as dead data.
